posts.title: Musings on success from someone seeking (The War of Art review)
posts.description: I just finished “The War of Art” by Steven Pressfield and I wanted to collect/formalize my thoughts about it and about achieving success generally. While there was a lot of weird spirituality in the book, I did come away feeling motivated to continue working away on my craft. It also reinforced some things that I’ve already believed. The main purpose in writing this post is to formalize my thought
